name: Brooklyn Flea (DUMBO)
note: Vintage, records and furniture under the Manhattan Bridge archway (80 Pearl St).

name: Chelsea Flea
note: Weekend antiques and vintage lot on W 25th St.

name: Smorgasburg Williamsburg
note: Huge outdoor food market on the waterfront at Marsha P. Johnson State Park (90 Kent Ave).

name: Smorgasburg Prospect Park
note: Sunday edition at Breeze Hill — enter at Lincoln Road.

name: Queens Night Market
note: Dozens of cuisines, most dishes $5–6. Paused during the US Open (late Aug–mid Sep). 7 train to 111 St.

name: Union Square Greenmarket
note: The city's biggest farmers market — cider donuts in the fall.

name: Grand Army Plaza Greenmarket
note: Saturday farmers market at the edge of Prospect Park.

name: Artists & Fleas Williamsburg
note: Indoor market of local makers and vintage sellers (70 N 7th St).

name: Bryant Park Winter Village
note: Free-admission ice rink and holiday shops (season usually late Oct–early Mar).

name: Chelsea Market
note: Indoor food hall right below the High Line.
